result:
I found 4 problems in the registration form: 1 major and 3 minor. The report is `qa/breaks/login-and-registration-2026-11-27.md`, and the report checker passed with 0 problems.

I did not test everything. I used about 30 actions, and the config doesn't set `explore.max_steps`, so I assumed 40. The gate blocked scripted browser code, so I worked one field at a time. Most of the email, password and answer catalogue values, Back or reload during a save, and the 5000-character value are untested. The report lists these as not tested.

1. **Major:** the same email in a different letter case registers as a new account. `reconqa@example`, `RECONQA@example` and `ReconQA@example` all returned 201. The atlas says emails must be unique. I repeated this once with the third casing, and it happened again.
2. **Minor:** a 41-character password is silently cut to 40 in Password, but Repeat Password keeps all 41. The form then says "Passwords do not match" with no hint why. I saw this once. The screenshot is `qa/breaks/shots/pw41.png`.
3. **Minor:** the Password counter shows "12/20" while the hint says 5-40 characters.
4. **Minor:** `reconqa@example` (no dot in the domain) is accepted and registers. It may be intended.

Two things held up: `reconqa@@example.test` is rejected with "Email address is not valid." And double-clicking Register sent exactly one POST.

The test run left three accounts behind: `reconqa@example`, `RECONQA@example` and `ReconQA@example`.

I can draft a bug for the major finding with `/reconqa:draft-bug qa/breaks/login-and-registration-2026-11-27.md #1`.
